notes: Diagnostics and reliability. Adds a dependency-free /healthz liveness route (returns build/version only, no database or auth), so a 1101 there clearly means a platform/wedge issue rather than an app bug. Connection errors are now scrubbed of any secret-shaped text before they are stored or logged, and a structured, rate-limited log line is emitted for easier diagnosis. Includes all 4.6.x fixes.
